You collect revenue directly into a wallet you control. You convert to local currency through P2P exchanges at near-market rates. The platform cannot suspend you because you are not on any platform.

content.text: What This Actually Is and Why It Matters: Cloudflare digital

Cloudflare R2 is a revolutionary object storage service that allows digital creators to store and deliver their products without incurring excessive fees. Unlike Gumroad, which charges a whopping 10% on every sale, NOWPayments offers a competitive 0.5% fee, making it an attractive option for those looking to maximize their earnings. At 100 sales per month on a $97 product, the fee difference retains $921, which can be a significant boost to a creator's revenue.
How the Architecture Works Under the Hood

The architecture behind Cloudflare R2 and NOWPayments is designed to provide a seamless and secure transaction experience. By leveraging the power of crypto payments, creators can receive payments in a variety of cryptocurrencies, including Bitcoin and USDT, without the need for intermediaries like Stripe or PayPal. This not only reduces fees but also ensures that creators have full control over their transactions and customer data.
Who This Is Built For and Why

This solution is specifically designed for digital creators who sell ebooks, courses, templates, fonts, presets, beats, plugins, and software. These creators often struggle to find reliable payment processing solutions that don't charge exorbitant fees or require them to sacrifice control over their customer data. By using Cloudflare R2 and NOWPayments, creators can focus on what they do best – creating high-quality digital products – without worrying about the intricacies of payment processing.
Cloudflare R2 and NOWPayments offer a powerful combination for digital creators looking to sell their products online without excessive fees.
The Components That Make It Work Together

The components that make this solution work together include Cloudflare R2 for object storage, NOWPayments for crypto payment processing, and a range of other tools and services that facilitate the creation and delivery of digital products. By integrating these components, creators can build a sovereign digital commerce stack that is tailored to their specific needs and goals. This stack can be deployed and scaled quickly, without the need for extensive technical expertise or significant upfront investment.
How to Use This Knowledge to Deploy Today

To deploy a sovereign digital commerce stack today, creators can start by selecting the right components and tools for their needs. This may involve choosing a storage solution like Cloudflare R2, a payment processor like NOWPayments, and a range of other services that facilitate the creation and delivery of digital products. By following a structured approach to deployment, creators can quickly and easily set up a scalable and secure commerce stack that meets their needs and goals.
How do I sell an ebook online without PayPal or Stripe?

Selling digital products without PayPal or Stripe is not a compromise — it is an upgrade for creators in restricted markets. The conventional platforms that seem like the standard path come with payout delays, geographic restrictions, platform fees of 5 to 10 percent, and the permanent risk of account suspension. A sovereign stack has none of these constraints. Your product page loads on Cloudflare Pages. Your buyer pays in USDT or Bitcoin through a NOWPayments checkout with live price feeds and QR code generation. Your backend verifies the payment on-chain and sends the download link within 30 seconds.

Your Deployment Checklist

To deploy a sovereign digital commerce stack, follow these steps: select a storage solution like Cloudflare R2, choose a payment processor like NOWPayments, set up a range of other services that facilitate the creation and delivery of digital products, integrate these components into a cohesive stack, test and refine the stack to ensure it meets your needs and goals, and finally, deploy the stack and start selling your digital products. For more information and resources, visit the shop URL: https://coremerch.github.io/products.html

Gumroad charges 10% on every sale, while NOWPayments charges 0.5%, resulting in a significant fee difference that can retain $921 at 100 sales per month on a $97 product.

Yes, Cloudflare R2 offers a free tier that allows creators to store and deliver their digital products without incurring excessive fees.

NOWPayments supports over 300 cryptocurrencies, including Bitcoin and USDT, allowing creators to receive payments in a variety of cryptocurrencies.
Do I need technical expertise to deploy a sovereign digital commerce stack?
No, deploying a sovereign digital commerce stack does not require extensive technical expertise, as many of the components and tools are designed to be user-friendly and accessible.
Can I scale my digital commerce stack as my business grows?
Yes, a sovereign digital commerce stack can be scaled quickly and easily as your business grows, without the need for significant upfront investment or technical expertise.
